purpose: Compare one structurally valid runtime report with one expected measurement contract on the host.
trigger: One runtime report has passed schema validation and one expected measurement contract is available.

inputs.name: report_path
inputs.description: Path to one structurally valid UTF-8 JSON runtime report.

inputs.name: contract_path
inputs.description: Path to one UTF-8 JSON measurement contract.

preconditions: contract_path identifies one readable schema-version-1 contract.
The caller treats compared values as declared claims, not independent observations.

outputs.name: contract_comparison_result
outputs.description: One passed or failed result with stable contract-mismatch codes.

postconditions: A passed result means the valid report matches the supplied contract within its declared tolerances.
The result does not independently observe geometry, execution, persistence, visuals, or exports.

implementation.target_environment: Host Python 3.9 or newer; invoke with --contract and do not launch SpaceClaim.
implementation.notes: This operation runs only the report-to-contract comparison path after report schema validation.

ambiguity_checks: No geometry object is selected; declared fields are matched by contract keys and names.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation has no geometry effect.

failure_modes.condition: The valid report or contract cannot be read, decoded, or parsed.
failure_modes.detection: Load both inputs with the bounded UTF-8 JSON loader.
failure_modes.safe_state: No comparison claim is accepted and the result is failed.

failure_modes.condition: The supplied contract has unsupported fields, values, or structure.
failure_modes.safe_state: No mismatch is interpreted as a model defect and the result is failed.

failure_modes.condition: The report differs from the contract in a declared target, body, group, feature, tolerance, or evidence boundary.
failure_modes.detection: Run compare_contract and retain each stable mismatch code.
failure_modes.safe_state: The report is not accepted for the supplied contract.

recovery.action: Provide readable UTF-8 JSON inputs and rerun the comparison.
Repair the contract with provenance and rerun the comparison.
Investigate the first mismatch, correct the report or contract at its source, and rerun the comparison.

validation.method: Run targeted report-validator tests with contracts covering targets, bodies, groups, features, tolerances, and evidence boundaries.
validation.expected: Matching data passes and every declared mismatch returns a stable issue code without an exception.

evidence_refs.notes: The single-action comparison boundary was reviewed.

design_only.notes: The operation compares one valid report with one contract.

evidence_refs.notes: Targeted host tests cover report-to-contract comparison behavior.

geometry_measurements.notes: Declared values are compared but not independently measured.

visual_review.notes: No viewport or image is reviewed.

evidence_level.notes: Evidence stops at design_only and host_checked.
